scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:contracts: cargo build --target wasm32v1-none --release -p rwa-token --manifest-path contracts/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path contracts/Cargo.toml
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
